page_title: Orchard for macOS — Control Apple Apps with AI

sources.entry: Orchard - MCP server that connects AI assistants to Apple apps.

summary.name: Orchard
summary.one_liner: Orchard is a macOS app that lets AI assistants (via Agent Skills, an MCP server, or a CLI) control 11 Apple apps through 52 local tools.
use_cases: Creating reminders and calendar events with natural language
Searching and sending emails or iMessages from an AI assistant
Controlling Apple Music playback and playlists
Running Shortcuts with parameters from an AI client
Scripting Mac apps from the terminal with JSON output
summary.what_it_does: Orchard exposes 52 tools across 11 native Apple apps (Reminders, Calendar, Clock, Mail, Apple Music, Notes, Messages, Maps, Weather, Contacts, Shortcuts) to AI tools. It offers three channels: an Agent Skill installable from the app for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, ChatGPT Desktop and Craft Agents; an orchard CLI with structured JSON output for scripts and shell use; and an MCP stdio server (orchard mcp) with 52 tools, 11 prompts and 18 resources for Cursor and other MCP clients. The page says tool calls run over a local Unix socket on the Mac, with no HTTP server or open ports, and that it is built in Swift on EventKit, MusicKit, WeatherKit and MapKit.
notable: Three access channels: Agent Skills, orchard CLI with JSON output, and MCP stdio server
Runs locally over a Unix socket with no HTTP server or open ports
Built in Swift on Apple frameworks such as EventKit, MusicKit, WeatherKit and MapKit
Shortcuts runs require explicit confirmation for every run
caveats: macOS only; the page lists no other platforms
Page lists 'Download Orchard Free' but does not detail any paid tiers or limits
